create_offscreen_renderer: create an OffScreenRenderer instance to render a MuJoCo model to an off-screen surface and retrieve pixel data
configure_scene_camera: configure a SceneCamera to set freeloook, tracking, or fixed mode for navigating a MuJoCo scene
manipulate_body_perturbation: create a Perturbation proxy to move or rotate a body in a MuJoCo simulation scene
toggle_render_settings: use RenderSettings to toggle rendering flags, visualization options, geom groups, and stereo buffering modes
setup_viewport: create a Viewport instance to manage render dimensions and convert screen coordinates to viewport coordinates
